top_signals.title: California warns all public school students of data stolen in contractor breach
top_signals.summary: The CDE released multiple statements over the last week warning the state’s students that assessment contractor Educational Testing Service (ETS) suffered a months-long data breach.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Fãs de música brasileira entram na divisão política
top_signals.summary: Barbara Nascimento conta como a música brasileira reflete a disputa política no país. Edição de Patricia Xavier.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Merz Urges Trump to Invite South Africa to G-20 Summit in Miami
top_signals.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz urged US President Donald Trump to reconsider his decision not to invite South Africa to the Group of 20 in Miami in December.

top_signals.title: Crypto firms, Wall Street push SEC to revise Regulation Crypto Assets as comments close
top_signals.summary: As the SEC’s comment period on a cryptocurrency proposal draws to a close, digital asset firms and Wall Street institutions have thoughts.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
